# Problem and data

## The task

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="54%"}

Predict **`posted_rate`**, the USD price of one truck load, from:

- **Lane:** pickup and delivery city, their coordinates, distance
- **Load:** equipment (Dry Van / Reefer / Flatbed), weight
- **Time and market:** date, `market_index` (daily, market-wide), `quote_signal` (weak, per load)

:::
::: {.column width="46%"}

### Data

- **Labelled:** 48,000 loads, Jan--Oct 2025
- **Predict:** 12,000 loads, Nov--Dec 2025; the metric is undisclosed
- **December chart:** Lexington $\rightarrow$ Fort Wayne, 360 mi, Dry Van, 32,000 lb; one prediction per day

:::
::::

## Key EDA findings

- **Out of time:** validation is Nov--Dec and labels end on 31 Oct $\Rightarrow$ time-based splits only.
- **Unseen cities:** 8 cities appear only in validation (12.1% of its rows) $\Rightarrow$ use coordinates and distance, not city IDs alone.
- **`market_index`** is one market-wide value per day with a weekly cycle (Thu peak, Sun trough); correlation 0.64 with the daily median rate per mile.
- **`quote_signal`** is weak (correlation $\approx 0.1$), with no sign of leakage.
- **Drift:** the rate level rises $\approx 6\%$ from Jan to Oct at a similar `market_index`; quarter-end spikes.
- **Low noise floor:** within lane $\times$ equipment $\times$ week, rate per mile varies by $\approx 2.2\%$ (CV).

## Data quality: what we fix and how

```{=latex}
\small\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}
\begin{tabular}{@{}l r l@{}}
\toprule
Issue (48,000 labelled loads) & Rows & Handling \\
\midrule
Corrupted rate: $\times$2.5--5.5 or $\times$0.2--0.45 & 677 (1.4\%) & drop (training, clean metrics) \\
Negative weight (a sign flip) & 292 (0.6\%) & absolute value + flag \\
Weight at the 47,500 lb cap / 5,000 lb floor & 1,204 / 32 & keep the value + flag \\
Missing weight & 300 (0.6\%) & keep NaN + flag \\
Missing \texttt{market\_index} & 374 (0.8\%) & that day's mean + flag \\
Distorted coordinates, consistent per city & all & use as internal geometry \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}

\vspace{0.8em}
{\footnotesize\color{accentgray} Corrupted labels: $|\log(\text{rpm} / \text{lane reference})| > \log 1.6$, in an empty gap (genuine $<0.23$, corrupted $>0.73$).}
```

# Validation

## Validation design: forward in time only

```{=latex}
\begin{center}
\def\tlKeyGap{4mm}
\input{figures/validation-timeline.tex}
\end{center}
\vspace{0.3em}
{\small Validation is out of time: every fold trains on the past and tests on the next two months.}
```

## Split protocol

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="52%"}

- **Select** on F1 + F2 only: the model design, the features and the hyperparameters.
- **Report** F3 (Sep--Oct) once, with the final choice.
- **Refit** on all clean Jan--Oct loads (47,323), 5 seeds; predict Nov--Dec.
- **Fixed iterations:** no early stopping on a reported fold.
- **Seeds:** 2--3 per configuration, mean $\pm$ sd.

:::
::: {.column width="48%"}

### Cold-start slice

On F3, remove every training row that touches 8 random cities (2 draws): held-out cities \$40.3 MAE vs \$34.4 for the rest.

### Metrics

MAE in \$ on clean rows (primary), plus MAPE, all-row MAE and RMSE; month bias as a diagnostic.

:::
::::

# Model and results

## Plain trees miss the second month

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="56%"}

```{=latex}
\def\mbShowFinal{0}
\def\mbHeight{5.0cm}
\input{figures/month-bias.tex}
```

:::
::: {.column width="44%"}

- **First test month:** $\approx$ 1% MAPE (May, July).
- **Second month:** 5.7--6.5% MAPE, up to 6.6% too low.
- Trees **cannot extrapolate** the rising price level.
- **Month proxies** (quote signal's monthly level, days to quarter end, trailing averages) let them reuse old levels.
- Adding time $t$: F3 MAPE 2.35%, but June still $-7.2\%$.

:::
::::

## The fix: split the price into level and cross-section

```{=latex}
\vspace{-0.6em}
\[
\log\frac{\text{rate}}{\text{distance}} \;=\;
\underbrace{\beta_0 + \beta_{\text{mi}}\,\bar m(d) + \beta_t\, t + \beta_{\text{qe}}\, q(d)}_{L(\text{date}):\ \text{market level, OLS}}
\;+\; \underbrace{f(\mathbf{x})}_{\text{CatBoost}}
\]
\vspace{0.1em}
\begin{center}
\input{figures/decomposition.tex}
\end{center}
{\scriptsize\color{accentgray} $\bar m$: day's mean market index $\cdot$ $t$: days since 1 Jan $\cdot$ $q$: quarter-end ramp $\cdot$ quote signal dropped from the trees}
```

## The market level $L(\text{date})$

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="64%"}

```{=latex}
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{../artifacts/backtest/level_index.png}
```

:::
::: {.column width="36%"}

- **Weighted $R^2$ 0.96** over 304 days.
- **Market index:** $+0.1 \Rightarrow +1.2\%$.
- **Trend:** $+0.51\%$ per 30 days.
- **Quarter-end ramp:** $+3.85\%$ on a quarter's last day.
- Every term is **known in advance**, so $L$ extrapolates.

:::
::::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="62%"}

```{=latex}
\input{figures/f3-mae.tex}
```

:::
::: {.column width="38%"}

- **\$37.5 MAE, 1.61% MAPE:** half the yardstick's error.
- **Seed noise:** \$0.1--0.5.
- **Month bias:** $-0.7\%$ / $-1.1\%$, was $-2.5\%$ / $-6.5\%$.
- **Error $\approx$ 1.6%** of the rate at every distance; Flatbed hardest.

## Tuning: the hyperparameters barely matter

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}

```{=latex}
\small\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.2}
\begin{tabular}{@{}l r r r@{}}
\toprule
F1+F2, 3 seeds & day-debiased & plain & fit (s) \\
\midrule
best trial (\#36) & 32.57 & 50.53 & 65.5 \\
CatBoost defaults & 32.91 & 50.63 & 23.7 \\
\midrule
gain & 0.34 & 0.10 & $\times$2.8 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}

\vspace{0.8em}
{\footnotesize MAE in \$. Day-debiased: each test day's median error removed, so the score isolates the trees.}
```

:::
::: {.column width="45%"}

- **Ablation:** masking weight costs \$26.6, coordinates \$1.9, every other family $<$ \$0.5.
- **Optuna:** 51 trials, TPE + median pruner.
- Gain inside the \$0.5 tie rule, fits $\approx 3\times$ slower $\Rightarrow$ **defaults kept**.
- The decomposition moved MAPE 2.35% $\rightarrow$ 1.61%.

:::
::::

## TabPack: a stronger learner is not the bottleneck

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="53%"}

```{=latex}
\input{figures/tabpack-f3.tex}

\vspace{0.5em}
{\scriptsize\color{accentgray} Mean over 3 seeds. Day-debiased: each test day's median error removed (cross-section only).}
```

:::
::: {.column width="47%"}

- **TabPack** (ICML 2026): 64 MLPs, sampled hyperparameters, greedy online ensemble; paper config, 38 min on a rented GPU.
- **Without $L$:** second month $-3.0\%$, the plain-trees failure.
- **In CatBoost's slot:** cross-section \$0.7 better, level offset worse.
- **Blend on F1+F2:** $w = 1$, CatBoost alone; gate fails $\Rightarrow$ **submission unchanged**.

:::
::::

# Summary

## Takeaways and next steps

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="52%"}

### Takeaways

- Validate the way the model will be used: forward in time, F3 scored once.
- **Structure beat tuning:** the level decomposition took F3 MAPE from 2.35% to 1.61%.
- **The learner is not the bottleneck:** TabPack was worth $\approx$ \$1, the decomposition $\approx$ \$20.
- Every data fix is explicit and flagged.
- December: weekly wave + trend + quarter-end ramp.

:::
::: {.column width="48%"}

### Limits $\rightarrow$ next steps

- Holidays not modelled $\rightarrow$ holiday priors.
- Trend risk bounded: freezing $t$ lowers mid-Dec by $\approx 0.8\%$.
- $\beta_{\text{mi}}$ and $\beta_t$ trade off over short windows.
- Flatbed weakest; metric unknown.
- Refit TabPack on train + val, or blend it on a level-corrected target; monotone weight constraint.

:::
::::
